market_view: SPY +4.71% but VIX is UP 12.1% on the day and +23.2% on the 5-day — this is a vol-spike bounce, not a healthy rally. IV expansion is actively destroying this short put spread's P&L despite underlying sitting 6.5% above the short strike.

SPY 675/665p.reasoning: Mid cost $1.71 is 1.24x the $1.38 credit — still under the 1.5x cut trigger of $2.07, but worst-case $2.33 already blows through it. VIX continuing to expand on a ripping SPY day is structurally wrong; this spread should be near 50% profit right now and it's a loser instead.
